display_name: LoRa 与 WiSig R17 原始及逐包归一化路径配对诊断
description: 在已曝光源 V 同包 clean/低城区对比原 R17(y) 与 R17(y/RMS)*RMS，诊断融合训练和原始对照的输入尺度契约差异。
authorization: 用户要求核查数据契约、真实冻结识别和筛查原因；复用合法已曝光源 V，同包固定预测后独立评分，不访问目标。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI CUDA FP32 / TF32 off, CPU independent scorer

data.contract_ref: lora_rx5_main_v1:392005; ManySig Main original 7/63/30 F0 seed392005; VALIDATED_ONCE source caches
data.representation: same original R17 checkpoint, action and frozen classifier per dataset; raw native observed input versus packet-RMS-normalized input and restored output scale
data.physical_ids_ref: existing first cross-data screen physical IDs, same paired channel observations
data.exposure: same source V RX panels and historical comparisons repeatedly exposed by prior development; no target input or truth

permissions.claim_scope: Source-V diagnostic only, no model training, TX read before prediction, target or threshold fitting. Uses source-trained R17 and original frozen classifiers; input identity and scenarios fixed. Real-gain control may have supervised ancestry.

checkpoint.initialization: Zero-parameter pass-through of the actual normalized-input R17 result; original R17 weights unchanged. Empty checkpoint exists only to use the existing frozen-prediction interface.

sources.role: WiSig original full R17 and action
LoRa E104 real-gain screen comparison only
WiSig frozen DURA v1 same-packet screen predictions
frozen same-ID LoRa-trained R69 architecture adaptation; distinct from original WiSig DURA v1 weights

checkpoint.selection_rule: No candidate promotion or weight selection: describe exact paired prediction changes and uncertainty between R17(y) and R17(y/RMS)*RMS on both fixed source V views, all logits produced before truth.

execution.gpu_policy: Two distinct GPUs from [7,1,3,6], each >=8192 MiB free; excludes active R17 teacher GPUs 0/5 and matched GPUs 2/4; preserve all other owners.
execution.stop_rule: Stop affected run on provenance/data-contract mismatch, occupied immutable output, no source-only checkpoint smoke, nonfinite loss/gradient, prediction matrix mismatch, query or truth-boundary violation; preserve partial artifacts and all other processes.

rows.method: normalized_r17: R17(y/RMS)*RMS vs original R17(y), no trainable parameters

data_overrides.training: none; source U only for real-checkpoint no-query smoke

rows.seed_notes: Support inapplicable; preregistered existing source V observations and fixed paired half permutation.
rows.budget_ref: zero updates; existing fixed source V 60 LoRa or 360 WiSig packets, clean and low urban

notes: This diagnostic evaluates original R17(y) against the current fusion pipeline zero-correction R17(y/RMS)*RMS, not a new fusion candidate. Labels identify normalized_r17 separately.

One real-checkpoint no-query U smoke precedes each row source V prediction; no model fitting, target IQ/truth/statistics, threshold or promotion. Only after all predictions freeze does independent CPU scorer read source V labels.

Source V panels, earlier results and WiSig R17 teacher source score already exposed. Same 60 LoRa / 360 WiSig IDs and physical observations allow paired attribution of input scaling only; other control predictions are reused as fixed.
No conclusion about target or formal acceptance follows from this source-only diagnostic. LoRa R69 is a source-trained structure adaptation, WiSig DURA v1 fixed original weights.
